business.title: What kind of business is this?
business.description: e.g. 'a café with 12 staff', 'a six-person design studio'.

tools.name: onboarding_status
tools.description: Every new hire's onboarding at a glance: open steps due within 7 days with overdue first, then each hire's start date, progress and what is still to do before day one, with hire and step ids. Call it first when asked what is due, what is overdue, or how someone's first weeks are going.

tools.name: add_hire
tools.description: Add a new hire with the standard plan (accounts, equipment and paperwork before day one, a first-day welcome, a first week with a buddy, and 30, 60 and 90-day check-ins), or update one: full name, role, first day (YYYY-MM-DD or a weekday like 'monday'), manager and buddy. An existing name is updated, never duplicated, and a new start date moves the open steps. Call it as soon as a new hire is mentioned.

tools.name: add_task
tools.description: Add a step to a new hire's plan: the hire, what needs doing, the phase (before day one, day one, first week, 30 days, 60 days or 90 days), who owns it, and a due date if one was given. An existing title is updated, never duplicated. Call it as soon as the person asks.

tools.name: complete_task
tools.description: Check off steps the moment the person says they are done: task (a step's id or words from its title, several separated by commas) and the hire's name, or the hire with a phase to check off everything in it. Call it before you reply.

tools.name: list_plan
tools.description: A whole plan, or every plan: each step with its phase, owner, due date and whether it is done.

tools.name: page_add_hire
tools.description: Add or update a new hire with the standard plan.

tools.name: page_complete_task
tools.description: Check off or reopen a step.

tools.name: page_add_task
tools.description: Add a step to a plan.
